purpose: Regression verification of scalar-probe representability, terminal candidate validation and required-recovery accounting on inspected development controls.

historical_reference.deterministic_overlap: All three scientific conditions intentionally match the inspected pilot; deterministic mean targets are expected to reproduce its target bytes after fresh preparation. These controls are reused development evidence, not untouched evidence.
historical_reference.poisson_comparison: Fresh branch-3 observations. Earlier branches contain different draws and support descriptive comparisons only.

construction.time: time_origin_ns + arange(bins) * bin_width_ns, including zero and last_time_ns
construction.components: Unchanged general-K finite-window reconvolution; one shared positive-later IRF shift; bin-width convolution factor; nonnegative FFT-roundoff clamp unchanged
construction.background: One post-convolution background in counts per bin
construction.kernel_normalization: Existing trapezoidal normalization on each supplied target grid; no endpoint zeroing or hidden preprocessing
construction.amplitudes: Use the declared pre-exponential amplitudes and verify their original detected-window fraction construction before sealing
construction.mean: sum_j A[j] * unit_component(time, prepared_generating_kernel, tau[j], shift) + background
construction.deterministic_kind: deterministic_expected_counts; use the existing explicit deterministic-objective path, never relabel as observed raw counts
construction.pairing: Each problem has one immutable observation/kernel checkpoint shared byte-for-byte by L-BFGS-B and TRF; no solver-specific sampling.

sampled.provenance: explicit synthetic sampled fixture; not measured

conditions.amplitude_semantics: Pre-exponential amplitudes; exact binary64 values copied from the immutable historical generating-parameter record, not estimates or initialization.
conditions.amplitude_rule: signal_photons * detected_signal_fractions[j] / sum(unit shifted reconvolved component j); verify derived values equal declared amplitudes during future preparation, otherwise stop

initialization: Unchanged data-only 109-template bank/NNLS/deduplication/diversity selection; no generating truth or historical production estimates as starts

scheduling.seed_call_lease_rule: Split 16000 across actual n_selected with integer quotient/remainder, unchanged from the scheduler; incomplete required seed coverage remains a rejection reason.
scheduling.seed_invocation_seconds_rule: 0.65 * 60 / n_selected; no invocation when n_selected is zero

numerical_acceptance.policy: Unchanged per-fit implementation at baseline commit. Solver success alone is insufficient; no aggregate acceptance percentage is required for calling this development verification complete.
required: valid finite physical candidate and predictions
candidate-specific local validation complete and passed
fresh predictions/components/objective consistent for exact returned candidate
no diagnostic descent above existing tolerance
numerical_acceptance.diagnostics: Full/restricted/unavailable conditioning remains distinct from acceptance and physical identifiability; stale validation cannot confer acceptance.

resources.ceiling_excludes: Preparation, coordinator verification/persistence and reporting; record their wall time separately. Worker startup and worker-side integrity checks are inside the external worker deadline.
resources.cleanup_failure: Stop immediately if process-tree termination cannot be confirmed; no next task or automatic retry.

preparation_accounting_proposal.basis: Six inputs, three K=1 unit-component evaluations each; no preparation optimization or retries. Instrument actual/failed work; do not infer it from success counts.

reporting_accounting_proposal.basis: At most one K=3 returned-prediction recheck per fit plus one K=3 generating-parameter reference per deterministic problem; no search, derivative probes, audits or refitting.

execution_lock_requirements.status: Not generated; manifest draft is not an execution lock
enforced: exact committed execution HEAD and committed source bytes
all numerical package Python files, every invoked preparation/worker/report script, pyproject.toml and any new execution-relevant adapter/configuration
raw manifest SHA-256 and canonical manifest digest
resolved settings, physical conditions, RNG procedure/namespaces, all six input mappings and all 12 task identities
Python version/executable hash, OS/machine, all installed dependency versions, module origins/hashes, loaded numerical-library binary hashes and actual thread counts
all listed environment/thread controls and deadlines/cleanup policy
distinct output location and lock identity
execution_lock_requirements.future_source_changes: Any execution adapter change requires review, tests and a new committed execution HEAD/fingerprint. It cannot be authorized by changing a Boolean in an older lock.

input_integrity.stage1: Seal and review source/environment/manifest/settings/task/RNG lock before input generation; obtain explicit execution approval.
input_integrity.stage2: Fresh output directory only. Durable preparation marker; generate and save all six individual hashed inputs; seal complete aggregate input_inventory.json atomically; re-read and verify every payload/hash/mapping before first worker.
input_integrity.resume: Verify execution identity, sealed aggregate inventory, every input and every prior attempt/result/transport before executing genuinely missing tasks. Never regenerate missing/corrupted inputs or overwrite/retry failed, timed-out, interrupted or completed attempts.
input_integrity.unsealed_preparation: Explicit incomplete_preparation; stop for separate recovery decision, never implicit retry.
input_integrity.reporting: Reject mixed/invalid provenance and corrupted transports; missing numerical outcomes remain in the planned denominator, but invalid provenance cannot yield verified scientific results.

outputs.inventory_identity: Canonical payload SHA-256, with exact file hashes for all six inputs; bind all 12 tasks.
outputs.immutable_checkpoint_names: Exact input/task filenames listed above; no replacement. Separate immutable attempt/start/worker transport evidence.

required: returned candidate/objective and best finite parameters/objective
numerical acceptance, complete reasons and solver termination separately
objective-gradient/residual-Jacobian availability; bounded failure coordinates, physical bounds, stencil evidence and omitted-event counts
joint versus conditional invocation counts; free/fixed coordinates, reported success, explicit failure/exhaustion and scalar numerical acceptance separately
planned/attempted/unattempted seeds, reserved/used recovery, required recovery completeness and capacity exhaustion
explicit promotions; returned, validation, assessment and diagnostic anchor identities
full/restricted/unavailable conditioning, included/fixed coordinates and reasons
model requests/calls, objective/residual/Jacobian evaluations, NNLS work, charged/completed component convolutions, unknown partial work, phase/call leases
numerical wall time, external worker wall time, timeout censoring, termination/cleanup, preparation/coordinator/report wall time separately
reporting.deterministic_objective_gap: For each mean target record C(y_mean, mu_returned) - C(y_mean, mu_generating), signed and unclipped; also show best-finite gap and computed C at generating parameters (mathematically zero, finite-arithmetic differences retained). No independent audit/global-optimum claim.
reporting.paired_solver_gap: On identical input hashes report signed C_LBFGSB - C_TRF for all finite outcomes, alongside acceptance and missing-result status.
reporting.parameter_errors: Canonical ordered lifetime/amplitude signed and absolute relative errors where truths are positive/distinct; background absolute error (relative only for nonzero truth); shift absolute ns error; detected-window fractions. Mark undefined/nonidentifiable component associations; report all finite and accepted-only denominators.
reporting.historical_comparison: Compare deterministic targets only after checking grid/kernel/mean hashes; disclose reused conditions. Different Poisson draws permit descriptive outcomes only, not controlled before/after attribution. Old 0/6 audit completeness stays historical; new audit status is not_scheduled.
reporting.interpretation: Mandatory provenance/numerical correctness separate from objective quality and scientific recovery. No 12/12 acceptance target, policy selection, 100/100 qualification target, discarded observations, automatic tuning or budget escalation.

diagnostic_targets.A: Complete physical scalar-probe coverage wherever representable, with actual decoded displacement and redundant-candidate statuses.
diagnostic_targets.B: Accurate classification of infeasible and genuinely unavailable feasible directions, including exhausted metadata adjustment.
diagnostic_targets.D: Preservation of detected objective descent above 0.001 and its acceptance consequence.
diagnostic_targets.E: Recovery reservations, leases, attempted/unattempted work and omitted-required-recovery reasons.
diagnostic_targets.F: Fresh assessment and full/restricted conditioning tied to returned candidates.
diagnostic_targets.G: Objective-quality and computational-cost summaries using all 12 attempts and six-per-solver denominators.

reporting.development_role: Already-inspected numerical-development controls. Independent qualification requires a separately frozen protocol.
